user.title: Add an ESC/POS printer
user.description: Use the printer's IP address and raw TCP port (usually 9100).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Check its address, port, and network connection.

abort.unsupported_device: This Epson printer model is not supported.

print_text.name: Print text
print_text.description: Print plain text or compose a receipt from styled text, images, to-do lists, QR codes, barcodes, and spacing blocks.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to print. Newlines are preserved. Use this or Composed content.

blocks.name: Composed content
blocks.description: Ordered styled text, image, to-do list, QR, barcode, and spacing blocks. Image paths are relative to /config/www.

printable_width_mm.name: Printable width
printable_width_mm.description: Select the roll width loaded in the TM-T70II. This setting controls image placement.

cut_paper.name: Cut paper
cut_paper.description: Disable this when you want to tear the receipt manually.

print_shopping_list.name: Print shopping list
print_shopping_list.description: Print the active items from a Home Assistant to-do list.

bonus.name: Barcode or QR data
bonus.description: Use auto to detect legacy underscore-prefixed QR, EAN-13 numbers, or Code 128.

item_prefix.name: Item prefix
item_prefix.description: Choose checkboxes, bullets, dashes, numbering, or no prefix.

thank_you.name: Thank-you message
thank_you.description: Auto prints it when a paid-back checklist is supplied.

bonus_type.name: Bonus code type
bonus_type.description: Auto preserves the existing detection rules; select a type to override them.

cut_paper.description: Disable this when you want to tear the receipt manually.
